en_title: GTA 6 Vice City NBA Court Revealed by Miami Heat
cn_title: 迈阿密热火队公布《GTA6》罪恶都市主题NBA球场
opus_summary: 迈阿密热火公布了《GTA6》Vice City主题球场，将在明天主场对阵密尔沃基雄鹿的比赛中限时使用一晚。球场采用粉蓝配色，印有游戏标志和Vice City字样；热火届时也将身穿特别版球衣。

paragraphs.en: The NBA's Miami Heat unveiled the special Vice City court they'll be playing on for one night only, tomorrow in a home game at the Kaseya Center against the Milwaukee Bucks, which doubles as the first time that superstar Heat center Giannis Antetokounmpo will play against the team he'd spend his whole career with before being traded to Miami in the offseason.
paragraphs.cn: NBA迈阿密热火队公布了特别打造的罪恶都市主题球场，他们将在明天于Kaseya Center主场对阵密尔沃基雄鹿队的比赛中使用这座球场，且仅此一晚。这场比赛也将是热火队超级巨星中锋扬尼斯·阿德托昆博首次对阵老东家：在休赛期被交易至迈阿密之前，他的整个职业生涯都在雄鹿队度过。

paragraphs.en: Posting on the team's X page (see below), the court features the GTA 6 Roman-numeral "VI" logo along with "Vice CIty" at center court and "I love Vice City" along the baselines. All of it is in the now-familiar hot pink and blue color scheme that have been at the forefront of Grand Theft Auto 6's branding.
paragraphs.cn: 球队在其X主页发布的内容（见下文）显示，球场中央印有《GTA6》的罗马数字「VI」标志以及「Vice CIty」字样，底线处则印有「I love Vice City」。所有这些都采用了如今已为人熟悉的亮粉色与蓝色配色，这一配色一直是《GTA6》品牌形象的核心。
为大家介绍罪恶都市主题球场🏀

paragraphs.en: See it for one night only, tomorrow vs Milwaukee. https://t.co/ZBpxND08hO
paragraphs.cn: 仅此一晚，明天对阵密尔沃基时见。https://t.co/ZBpxND08hO

paragraphs.en: In tomorrow's game, the Heat will also be wearing one-off Vice City jerseys , though they sadly still say "Heat" on them rather than "Vice City." On the plus side, there is a whole bunch of Vice City merch available on the Miami Heat team store website .
paragraphs.cn: 明天的比赛中，热火队还将穿上仅此一次的罪恶都市主题球衣，但遗憾的是，球衣上写的仍是「Heat」，而不是「Vice City」。好消息是，迈阿密热火队的球队商店网站上有大量罪恶都市主题周边在售。

paragraphs.en: After years of waiting, the release of GTA 6 is finally imminent (shout-out to all of the consoles "visiting" New Zealand in order to play a little earlier !). Make sure to update your preload if you haven't already so that you don't have to download anything before playing, and remember to stay in school (if applicable), as there might be a gift card in it for you . For those working, it looks like a whole bunch of you are taking PTO this week .
paragraphs.cn: 经过多年的等待，《GTA6》终于即将发售（向所有为了早一点玩到游戏而「造访」新西兰的主机致意！）。如果你还没有更新预载内容，记得更新，以免开始玩之前还要下载任何东西；也要记得留在学校上课（如果适用），因为你可能会因此得到一张礼品卡。至于上班的人，看来你们当中有很多人本周正在休带薪假。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN负责前瞻内容的执行编辑，也是IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人和《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自North Jersey，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan和他辩论这个问题。
